build_nose_hoover_nvt_thermostat: build a NoseHooverNVT thermostat with target temperature and damping time for NVT molecular dynamics
build_bussi_thermostat: build a Bussi stochastic velocity rescaling thermostat with target temperature and coupling time
build_langevin_thermostat: build a Langevin thermostat with target temperature and friction coefficient for stochastic dynamics
save_restore_thermostat_state: save and restore thermostat state for checkpointing molecular dynamics simulations
